030package dev.visdb.seesaw.utils;
031
032import java.awt.EventQueue;
033import java.io.IOException;
034import java.io.Reader;
035import java.io.StringReader;
036import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
037
038import javax.swing.SwingWorker;
039
040import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.BackgroundDecorator;
041import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.BorderDecorator;
042import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.Decorator;
043import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.DecoratorSupplier;
044import dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators.TextStyles;
045import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.Utils;
046
047/**
048 * This class is used internally to initialize CentralLookup defaults
049 * and text style defaults.
050 * For CentralLookup, only elements that are not already set are initialized.
051 * It is invoked automatically when either SSComponent/SSCommon
052 * or RowsModel is referenced (impossible to use library without these).
053 * <p>
054 * Certain initialization access to this library does not force this initialization,
055 * for example first access to the library could be something like:
056 * {@snippet lang="java":
057 *     public static void main(String[] args) {
058 *         // Add application defaults to CentralLookup.
059 *         CentralLookup lkup = CentralLookup.getDefault();
060 *         // lkup.add(anInstanceofSomething);
061 *         // keep adding stuff as needed
062 *         LookupDefaults.init();
063 *         // ...
064 *         DbSupport supp = DbSupportFactory.setupLookup(dbConnection);
065 *     }
066 * }
067 */
068public class LookupDefaults {
069  private LookupDefaults() {}
070  private static final System.Logger logger = System.getLogger(LookupDefaults.class.getName());
071  static {
072    Utils.getGlobalEventBus();
073  }
074
075  private static boolean initialized;
076  /**
077   * This is automatically called around first library use,
078   * not including CentralLookup, to initialize
079   * default CentralLookup elements that are required by the library
080   * and are not already present or setup by the application.
081   * <p>
082   * Might be better to initialize where needed if no value.
083   * But this does serve to document some of the things that can be put in lookup.
084   */
085  public static void init() {
086    if (initialized)
087      return;
088
089    initStyles();
090
091    CentralLookup lkup = CentralLookup.getDefault();
092
093    //
094    // There should be a DecoratorStyle.
095    //
096    Decorator.DecoratorStyle style = lkup.lookup(Decorator.DecoratorStyle.class);
097    if (style == null)
098      lkup.add(Decorator.DecoratorStyle.BORDER);
099
100    //
101    // There should be BORDER and BACKGROUND decorators.
102    //
103    var decos = lkup.lookupAll(DecoratorSupplier.class);
104
105    boolean hasBorder = false;
106    boolean hasBackground = false;
107    for (var deco : decos) {
108      if (deco.getDecoratorStyle().equals(Decorator.DecoratorStyle.BORDER))
109        hasBorder = true;
110      if (deco.getDecoratorStyle().equals(Decorator.DecoratorStyle.BACKGROUND))
111        hasBackground = true;
112    }
113    if (!hasBorder)
114      lkup.add(new DecoratorSupplier(() -> { return new BorderDecorator(); }));
115    if (!hasBackground)
116      lkup.add(new DecoratorSupplier(() -> { return new BackgroundDecorator(); }));
117
118    //
119    // There should be a BorderDecoratorPaint.
120    //
121    if (lkup.lookup(BorderDecorator.BorderDecoratorPaint.class) == null)
122      lkup.add(new BorderDecorator.BorderDecoratorPaint());
123
124    initialized = true;
125  }
126
127  private static boolean initializedStyles;
128
129  /**
130   * Set up the default styles; does nothing if any styles are already set.
131   * If an app wants to add some of it own styles, with names that do not
132   * conflict, this should be called first rather than waiting for the
133   * default initialization.
134   * If an app want to replace the default styles then add them before
135   * this is called.
136   */
137  public static void initStyles() {
138    if (initializedStyles)
139      return;
140
141    if (!TextStyles.getStyleNames().isEmpty())
142      return;
143
144    if (EventQueue.isDispatchThread()) {
145      String msg = "LookupDefaults.initStyles() invoked from EDT.";
146      Exception ex = new Exception(msg);
147      logger.log(Level.ERROR, msg, ex);
148
149      // Problem if EDT tries to access TextStyles before loading complete.
150      new SwingWorker<Object, Object>() {
151        @Override
152        protected Object doInBackground() throws Exception {
153          initStyles();
154          return null;
155        }
156      }.execute();
157      return;
158    }
159
160    Reader reader = new StringReader(DEFAULT_STYLES_JSON);
161    try {
162      TextStyles.loadStylesFromJson(reader, "LookupDefaults");
163    } catch (IOException ex) {
164      logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
165    }
166    initializedStyles = true;
167  }
168  /** This can be manually loaded if the Styles get cleared. */
169  public static final String DEFAULT_STYLES_JSON = """
170        {
171          "negative_number": {
172            "foreground": "red"
173          }
174        }
175        """;
176}
